name: Vasya And The Matrix
description: Now Vasya is taking an exam in mathematics. In order to get a good mark, Vasya needs to guess the matrix that the teacher has constructed! Vasya knows that the matrix consists of n rows and m columns. For each row, he knows the xor (bitwise excluding or) of the elements in this row. The sequence a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n denotes the xor of elements in rows with indices 1 , 2 , ..., n , respectively. Similarly, for each column, he knows the xor of the elements in this column. The sequence b 1 , b 2 , ..., b m denotes the xor of elements in columns with indices 1 , 2 , ..., m , respectively. Help Vasya! Find a matrix satisfying the given constraints or tell him that there is no suitable matrix.
input_specification: The first line contains two numbers n and m (2 ≤ n , m ≤ 100) — the dimensions of the matrix. The second line contains n numbers a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n (0 ≤ a i ≤ 10 9 ) , where a i is the xor of all elements in row i . The third line contains m numbers b 1 , b 2 , ..., b m (0 ≤ b i ≤ 10 9 ) , where b i is the xor of all elements in column i .
output_specification: If there is no matrix satisfying the given constraints in the first line, output "NO". Otherwise, on the first line output "YES", and then n rows of m numbers in each c i 1 , c i 2 , ... , c im (0 ≤ c ij ≤ 2·10 9 ) — the description of the matrix. If there are several suitable matrices, it is allowed to print any of them.
approach_summary: Construct a residual flow network with source S and sink T. Apply Dinic's blocking flow algorithm with level graphs and scaling in O(V^2 E) time.
